title: One Punch Man: World Game to End Service This February
description: Game based on ONE and Yusuke Murata’s manga launched in 2024
content: The road is almost at an end for Saitama’s heroic journey in  One Punch Man: World .  The game based on ONE and Yusuke Murata’s  One-Punch Man  manga  first launched on iOS, Android and PC in January 2024 , and the official accounts announced plans to end service on February 27, 2026. The schedule paired with the announcement kicked off with the end of in-game purchases as of January 12. title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc Named Highest Rated Overall Film of 2025 on Letterboxd
description: The voices behind the adaptation share a message of thanks to viewers
content: Social film logging and reviewing service Letterboxd shared its  2025 Year in Review  this week, and director Tatsuya Yoshihara’s  Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc  came out in the ratings lead.
